title: Change how many seats you pay for

steps.say: Once you are subscribed, the seat count is edited in place. Step it up or down with the stepper above, or type the number straight into the box.
This button then reads Update, with the new monthly total on it. Tapping it changes your existing subscription — no second checkout, no new card details.
While the count matches what you already pay for, the button simply says current and does nothing, so you cannot double-bill yourself by tapping it twice.
steps.terminal: That is seat editing — grow or shrink as staff come and go. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
